name: Jack Tuszynski
abstract_title:
An overview of the experimental tests of the Orch OR theory:

UV and visible photon absorption/re-emission by tubulin and microtubulesand effects of anesthetic molecules
abstract: The Orch OR theory suggests consciousness depends on quantum processes in microtubules inside brain neurons. Here, we describe two sets of never-before-performed crucial experiments designed to demonstrate quantum processes in microtubules, and to test their sensitivity to anesthetic molecules. Since anesthesia is the most direct observable effect on consciousness, experimental evidence for comparable effects on quantum processes in microtubules would support the major tenet of Orch OR.
